description: nf-core/sarek samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 3.10.0 schema. Germline and somatic variant calling from WGS, WES or targeted DNA sequencing.

tools.help: comma list of callers. Germline: haplotypecaller, deepvariant, freebayes, strelka, manta, tiddit, cnvkit. Tumour/normal pairs only: mutect2, ascat, controlfreec, msisensorpro, muse. Not available: vep, snpeff, bcfann, snpsift, merge (their caches are not staged on Luria).

aligner.help: bwa-mem2 is faster but its index build needs far more memory

wes.help: true for exome or targeted capture; intervals must then name the kit's BED

intervals.help: the capture kit's target BED as a path on the cluster; whole-genome runs get the staged GATK calling regions

skip_tools.help: comma list from the schema's skip_tools, e.g. baserecalibrator

pipeline.name: nf-core/sarek
pipeline.core_rule: One row per FASTQ pair: patient, sample, lane, fastq_1, fastq_2, with status 0 (normal) or 1 (tumour) and sex XX/XY/NA. The schema also accepts spring, BAM, CRAM and VCF inputs; the supported path here is FASTQ.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
patient, sample, lane and fastq_1 must be populated; fastq_2 blank means single-end.
patient + sample + lane must be unique: rows of one library differ by lane.
status is 0 (normal) or 1 (tumour). Leave it to the param atlas and the pairing check: never guess it from a name alone.
Tumour-pair tools (mutect2, ascat, controlfreec, msisensorpro, muse) need a tumour and a matched normal for every patient; configure_run refuses them otherwise.
For exome or targeted capture set wes=true and give intervals the kit's BED path on the cluster; never use the whole-genome calling regions for capture data.
Do not request vep, snpeff, bcfann, snpsift or merge: their caches are not staged on Luria.
notes: DNA variant calling on the GATK GRCh38 bundle staged under refs/GATK.GRCh38 (luria/refs/stage_dna_refs.sh). dbSNP, known indels, gnomAD and the panel of normals are passed from that bundle; the BWA index is built from the FASTA on every run.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/sarek input samplesheet.

patient.description: Patient or subject id; a tumour and its matched normal share it.
patient.validation_hints: The UID of the PAT sample in the leaf's lineage; with no PAT, the topmost ancestor's UID. Never invent a shared id to make a pair.

sex.description: Genetic sex; used by copy-number tools.
sex.validation_hints: From the lineage's Sex field (PAT); NA when absent.

status.validation_hints: Set from the param atlas verdict; confirmed with the user when the metadata does not decide it.

sample.description: Sample id; repeat across lanes of one library.
sample.validation_hints: The NExtSEEK D.SEQ UID, so results map back to the sample record.

lane.description: Lane or read group of this FASTQ pair; must differ between rows of one sample.
lane.validation_hints: The L00N token from the file name when present, else 1, 2, 3 in file order.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path from the sample's Link_PrimaryData / File_PrimaryData.

fastq_2.description: Full path to read 2 FASTQ; blank for single-end.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/sarek samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of DNA libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for variant calling from DNA. For variants from RNA-seq use rnavar; for HLA alleles use hlatyping.
population_priority: One row per FASTQ pair; sample = the D.SEQ UID; lane distinguishes pairs of one sample.
patient = the PAT UID in the lineage, so tumour and normal of one person share it.
status from the param atlas verdict; leave the pairing confirmation to configure_run.
Say plainly that variant annotation is off and why.
final_checks: No two rows share patient + sample + lane.
For capture data, wes=true and intervals names the kit's BED.

runtime.basis: First guess for one 16-CPU Luria node (Nessie's default submit); not yet measured on Luria. Refine from real runs.
runtime.setup_label: building the BWA index for GATK.GRCh38 (every run repeats it)
